# S18 — An item has nowhere to put a note

**Findings:** agent surface · **Size: M** · **Tree:** slicer

## Why

`Slice.lead` and `Slice.notes` are the free-form paragraphs around a slice's metadata
line. They are read by `render` and written by `migrate` and `import` — but no CLI
command can reach either, so a slice created with `promote` has them empty forever.

`done --note` exists but writes only to `log.jsonl`; it never appears in `show`, `render`
or the TUI. `remove --reason` is the only free text that survives onto an item. So there
is no way to say "tried X, it did not work" against a slice and have anyone see it.

## Implement

`slicer note ID [--file/--stdin]` appending a paragraph to `Slice.notes`, and make the
TUI's `e` reach them. Then decide whether notes should carry a timestamp — they are the
closest thing to a discussion thread, and dated entries age better than undated ones.

**Not in this slice:** authorship; nothing in slicer records who did anything, and adding
identity is its own decision.
